items.stem: A team wants to launch a new subscription model immediately at full scale. What is the strongest business-model-innovation objection?

options.text: The riskiest assumptions should be tested cheaply before committing to full scale
options.rationale: Correct: testing key assumptions first reduces the cost of being wrong.

options.text: New models should never be subscription-based
options.rationale: Subscriptions can be excellent; the issue is testing.

options.text: Scaling first always lowers unit cost enough to justify risk
options.rationale: Scale does not de-risk unvalidated assumptions.

options.text: Business models cannot be tested in advance
options.rationale: They can be tested with cheap experiments.

items.explanation: Correct: testing key assumptions first reduces the cost of being wrong.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO elements belong to the value-capture side of a business model? (Select TWO.)

options.text: The revenue model and pricing mechanism
options.rationale: Correct: pricing and revenue model capture value.

options.text: The cost structure that determines margin
options.rationale: Correct: cost structure governs how much captured value is retained.
Onboarding is delivery, not value capture.
Visual identity is not value capture.
Operations layout is delivery, not capture.

items.explanation: Correct: pricing and revenue model capture value.

items.stem: An experiment shows weak demand for a new offering, but the team reinterprets the data as positive and proceeds. What is the core failure?

options.text: Confirmation bias is overriding honest reading of disconfirming evidence
options.rationale: Correct: ignoring disconfirming evidence defeats the purpose of testing.

options.text: The experiment should have been larger before any decision
options.rationale: Size is secondary to interpreting the signal honestly.

options.text: Experiments are not useful for business models
options.rationale: Experiments are central to model innovation.

options.text: Weak demand always means the market is wrong
options.rationale: Blaming the market ignores the evidence.

items.explanation: Correct: ignoring disconfirming evidence defeats the purpose of testing.
